author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
You all know I LOVE Golden Demon! 

It's one of my favourites Warhammer events ever and every single year I do my best to turn up and enter whatever I think is the best thing I painted that year! 

But this year I decided I would try and enter it FOR REAL ... but with only one week to go... 

So in this video I do my best to do a potentially GOLDEN DEMON WINNING PAINTJOB on a Warhammer miniature smaller than my fingernail, and also tell you guys all about one of my favourite and i think often overlooked Golden Demon Categories, the Epic scale Category!!

Hope you enjoy :D

CHAPTERS!

00:00 - INTRO!
02:15 - The Plan!!
07:45 - Painting the Tiny mini!
18:10 - Basing (yaaay)
21:10 - Going to GOLDEN DEMON!!
24:00 - How I did....
